overview: A 8 year old boy playing with a camcorder, while recording his house and atmosphere he accidentally records audio of his father talking on the phone, several phone conversations of the father reveal a meticulous planning of a POGROM.  On 28 February 2002, a three-day period of inter-communal (Hindus and Muslims) violence began in the western Indian state of Gujarat. This was the first pogrom where telephones and cellphones were used as a major operational tool and the riots were meticulously per-planned, thousands of people (official number : 1,044 ) mostly Muslims were killed in the three day pogrom. The riots were particularly carried out to target Muslim.
